Updates loyalty member data.

Accepts ``data`` JSON object with ``custom_properties`` and ``member_dates`` JSON objects.

E.g. ``{"custom_properties":{"contest_participant":true},"member_dates":{"identifier":"birthday","date":"2004-01-01"}}``.

Note that all values in ``custom_properties`` object will be stored as strings,
e.g. ``false`` will become ``"f"``, and ``123`` will become ``"123"``.
